subject: acc-dy
title: ACC.DY.------INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 406 (R(AS)CM(II)-50). ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the subject; INFO-F (information focus) is the partner. From the subject: AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree), LG-DY (logical dynamics) and INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). From AFI-1: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From LG-DY: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) and LANG-D. From INDIV-DY: MOT-DY. From SPT-DY: TR (transformation) and HI-P (high purpose).
